name: Sensei
source:
The protagonist of the game. At the request of his former teacher, Kinpachi Sakamoto, he became the substitute homeroom teacher for Class 3-B. 28 years old. Serves as the Japanese Language teacher. He used to be a full-time teacher, but a certain incident forced him to step away from the teaching profession for some time.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
